questions.question: What does Ezekiel 46 regulate?
options: The boundaries of the land among the tribes
The duties of the gatekeepers and singers
The measurements of the temple courts
The prince's offerings on Sabbaths and feasts
questions.answer: The prince's offerings on Sabbaths and feasts

questions.question: Through which gate was the prince to enter and worship?
options: The south gate, where all of the people gathered
The east gate, which was opened on the Sabbath
The north gate, used only by the priests
The inner gate, leading to the altar
questions.answer: The east gate, which was opened on the Sabbath

questions.question: The people were to enter by one gate and leave by the opposite gate during appointed feasts.
The gate of the inner court facing east shall be shut on the six working days, but opened on the _____.
The _____ shall worship at the threshold of the gate, going in among the people.
